metadata.title: Valencia Sud historical flood evidence
metadata.method: CEMS photo-interpretation of post-event aerial imagery; original geometry and attributes preserved. Added feature IDs, layer and source_file properties only.
metadata.attribution: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2024 European Union), [EMSR773] Valencia Sud (AOI30): Grading Map, v1
metadata.license_name: Copernicus EMS On-Demand Mapping terms and conditions
limitations: Historical post-event evidence, not a live flood extent or prediction.
Flood trace polygons are mapped residual traces, not the full event inundation footprint.
Absence of a polygon does not establish safety or lack of flooding.
Damage grades retain source uncertainty: Possibly damaged must not be presented as confirmed damage.
Source states thematic accuracy may be lower because of distortions in some areas.
No confidence scores, water depth, forecast probabilities or current road passability are supplied.
The public data layer is independent of the synthetic scenario model.

summary_from_source_map.note: Rounded figures printed in original product; not model predictions. Population estimates intentionally omitted.
